datasets.name: InterAct (Ho et al., SCA 2025; NOT the same-name HOI dataset)
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 stated on official project and HF card; no registration/gating encountered
datasets.format: BVH at 30fps, 482 files = 241 paired scenarios; SQLite actors/scenarios databases
datasets.completeness: All original BVH files, full small root metadata; intentionally omit retarget duplicate (3,308,864,058 bytes), audio, faces and rendered video
datasets.relevance: Longer objective-driven dynamic interaction; can inspect silent full-body response and task context rather than greeting only. Role labels are scenario labels, not validated body-only perceived status.
limitations: Do not use speech/face in our perceptual comparison.
Source performed scenarios not a response-policy ground truth.
README/project mention sit/walk/stand annotations; exact released location not yet verified.
Foot contact, pair synchronization lengths and motion fidelity need local validation after download.

recording_mapping.method: Parse <date>_<actor>_<scenario>.bvh; group by date/scenario; join scenario_id to scenarios.db, NOT all scenario DB rows

datasets.name: ShakeFive2
datasets.license: Research purposes only; official page asks users to contact authors if using it in work. No author has been contacted. Do not treat downloaded availability as clearance for publication/redistribution.
datasets.format: Kinect2 frame-based XML skeleton metadata, 153 associated video clips
datasets.completeness: Full metadata, renderer source and background archives queued; videos deferred (partial archive retained, not usable).
datasets.relevance: Object passing/explaining provide non-greeting alternatives and real paired observation.
limitations: Kinect estimates, not high-fidelity optical animation
Author-contact condition remains before project use

datasets.name: Inter-X
datasets.license: Custom noncommercial scientific/education/artistic use, no distribution; download/use clause states agreement. No terms accepted and no form submitted.
datasets.format: 120fps SMPL-X NPZ and (T,64,3) skeleton NPY per P1/P2
datasets.relevance: Strong candidate for action/reaction structure; actor order and familiarity are not status labels.

datasets.name: InterHuman / InterGen
datasets.license: Official README states CC BY-NC-SA4.0 plus requests for noncommercial access and prohibits redistribution; do not assume unrestricted sharing.
datasets.format: Paired 3D interactive motion with natural language descriptions; exact released archive uninspected
datasets.relevance: Broad interaction generation base, but no movement-only status labels confirmed.

datasets.name: CHI3D
datasets.format: Both-person 3D joints, GHUM and SMPL-X parameters; 631 sequences with contact labels
datasets.published_archive_sizes: Train 3.5GB; test 647MB. Download page explicitly requires valid account.
datasets.relevance: Contact/close-interaction quality reference, not a status/style dataset.

datasets.name: SBU Kinect Interaction
datasets.relevance: Approach/depart/push and other interactions; older low-resolution Kinect skeletons; need direct primary license confirmation before reuse.
